_help: One file per game, named <series>-g<n>.json (for example main-event-round-4-1-g1.json). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Remove the optional blocks you cannot fill. Files starting with _ are never read.
_help_ids: series and team ids are the ones in the site URLs: /matches/<series> and /teams/<team>. Team tags (T1, KC, MKOI) work too. Champion names as shown on lolesports.com, e.g. K'Sante, Lee Sin.
_help_series: stage, date, bestOf and teams are only needed when the series is not on the site yet (for example a quarterfinal that was just paired). stage is one of: playin, swiss, quarterfinals, semifinals, final. date is the series start in UTC.
_help_game: blue and red are the sides in this game; winner is one of them; duration is mm:ss or a number of seconds.
_help_draft: Five picks per side in role order (top, jungle, mid, bot, support). Bans in the order they were taken, up to five per side; leave the bans block out if you do not have them.
_help_objectives: Optional team totals from the end-of-game screen. Leave the whole block out if you do not have them: the page then hides team stats for this game instead of showing zeros.
_help_players: Optional kills/deaths/assists per player (player id from the site URL or in-game name), five per side in any order.
